summary: Frontend-only verification that CommsHubPage is re-surfaced under Service Desk → Options → Comms and is fully translated in EN and DE. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, navigated to /service-desk, expanded Options in the left sidebar, clicked the Comms item (data-testid=desk-option-comms), and confirmed the Comms Hub mounts (data-testid=comms-page) with both Templates and Activity tabs. Verified no raw i18n key leaks (service.comms_*, service.nav_comms) in EN and after PATCH /api/account/profile {language:'de'} and reload. Verified regression: all other Options items (Imports, Integrations, Audit, Account settings, Engineers) still present. Language reverted to 'en' at cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: de.json has TWO nav_comms keys (line 5288 = 'Comms', line 6779 = 'Kommunikation'). JSON parsers keep the LAST occurrence, so the effective DE value is 'Kommunikation' — however the sidebar rendered 'Comms'. Investigate whether the second occurrence lives under a different namespace and confirm intended DE label. If 'Comms' is the desired brand label, remove the duplicate to avoid confusion; if 'Kommunikation' is intended, ensure the sidebar label picks it up.

In embedded mode the CommsHubPage does not render the localized page title 'Kundenkommunikations-Hub' (comms_title). This appears to be by design because ServiceOpsEmbeddedContext collapses the hero, but the title/subtitle strings become unused inside the Desk shell. Consider surfacing a compact translated heading inside the embed for parity with Compliance/Parts/Billing tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comms Hub is embedded inside Service Desk via Options menu (data-testid=desk-option-comms). Options item ids are: imports, integrations, comms, audit, account, engineers (note it's 'imports' not 'import'). PATCH /api/account/profile with {language:'de'|'en'} + reload switches UI language. Empty Activity state DE = 'Noch keine Kommunikation gesendet.'. de.json has a duplicate nav_comms key worth cleaning up.
